---
title: "Registry Authentication"
description: "Configure Podman Desktop with credentials for GitHub Container Registry"
order: 1
---



## Creating an access token

For Podman Desktop to push images to the GitHub Container Registry (GHCR) on
your behalf, or pull private images that your account has access to, you need
to create a *personal access token* for your GitHub account. A token works like
a password that is limited to specific actions.


::: {.callout-note collapse=true}
## Alternative Registries

If for some reason you do not want to use the GitHub Container Registry,
everything in this module can be done with a Docker account (for `dockerhub.io`)
or a Red Hat account (for `quay.io`). You will need to create a [personal access
token for
Docker](https://docs.docker.com/security/access-tokens/personal-access-tokens/)
or a [robot account for
quay.io](https://docs.quay.io/glossary/robot-accounts.html),
and enter those credentials to Podman Desktop in *Settings > Registries*.
:::

This is most easily done by going to
[github.com/settings/tokens/new?scopes=write:packages](https://github.com/settings/tokens/new?scopes=write:packages)
in your browser. You will have to log in to GitHub if you aren't already.
This takes you to the Developer Settings page to create a new 'classic' token
with permission to read and write packages. Enter a name to identify the token,
e.g., 'Push to GHCR', and choose an expiry date or disable it entirely; 
the most important aspect for security is that you do *not* tick additional
scopes that would grant the ability to modify your repositories.
Scroll down and press
*Generate token*.

![Generating a token with read and write access to
ghcr.io. Do not check any other boxes.](assets/github-create-token.png)

The new token will then be displayed. Make sure to save it somewhere secure,
such as a password manager, as it will only be shown once. Treat it like a
password, and never share it or add it to a public space like a code repository.

## Adding the token to Podman Desktop

Back in Podman Desktop, go to *Settings > Registries* and press *Configure* next
to GitHub in the registry list. Enter your GitHub username as the *Username*,
and the access token you created above as the *Password*. Do *not* enter your
GitHub account password here.

![Configuring Podman Desktop to authenticate with ghcr.io using your personal
access token](assets/podman-configure-github.png)

You should be all set for the rest of the Module.

::: {.callout-note collapse=true}
## Authentication not working?

Check that:

- the password you entered is the full token, including its `ghp_` prefix
- the token has not expired
- the token, as shown in your GitHub Developer Settings, has read and write
  access to packages
:::
